info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-Delete Payments Payments Void-v4-spec
info.description: The Payments Void API allows users to reverse previously processed payment transactions efficiently. This endpoint is essential for correcting errors and addressing customer requests for refunds. It enables authorized parties to ensure that funds are returned to clients seamlessly and in compliance with financial regulations. Typical consumers of this API include merchants, payment processors, and financial institutions, all seeking to maintain accurate transaction records while enhancing customer satisfaction.

delete.description: This endpoint allows you to void a payment transaction that was previously processed. By sending a DELETE request to this endpoint, you can effectively cancel the payment, ensuring that it is no longer reflected in the transaction records.

requestBody.description: The request body for voiding a payment transaction. This action cancels an existing payment and requires specific details about the payment to be voided.

201.description: The void request was successfully processed, and the payment has been cancelled.

DeletePaymentsPaymentsVoidRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for void operations in payments. It is expected to be a string indicating the specific details of the void operation.

DeletePaymentsPaymentsVoidResponse_201.title: Payment Void Operation Response

status.description: Indicates if the operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: The reference number associated with the payment.

resultId.description: The unique identifier for the result of the void operation.

state.description: The current state of the payment after the void operation.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the void operation in milliseconds.

message.description: Additional information or message returned with the response.

DeletePaymentsPaymentsVoidResponse_201.description: This schema represents the response for a successful payment void operation.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: The identifier of the user or system that created the record.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the record was created in ISO 8601 format.

automated.description: Indicates whether the operation was performed automatically.

AuditInfo.description: This schema provides information related to the audit details of the payment operation.

x-processing-time.description: The time, in milliseconds, taken to process the request. A shorter time indicates a more efficient operation.
